name: Cryotop rapid vitrification of four oocytes
plain_name: Vitrify oocytes on a thin carrier
description: Rapid cryoprotectant-assisted vitrification is physically different from slow freezing and frozen histological sectioning.
keywords: Vitrify oocytes on a thin carrier
reported_equipment: Kitazato Cryotop, cooling rack and LN2 container

requirements.rationale: This procedure needs the actual vitrification carrier/process, not a chamber reaching the same nominal temperature.
Direct LN2 immersion is specified by the protocol.
This selected protocol carries4oocytes; the manufacturer's maximum is4.

missing_information: Medium composition,timing,operator technique and warming are essential; Lean does not prove survival or clinical eligibility.
No sample chamber temperature range or guaranteed cooling rate has been invented for an open LN2 carrier.
confirmation_note: Source-specific requirements reviewed by the catalog author on 2026-10-31. They describe the selected procedure, not a universal limit. Users must confirm them before a run; edits require confirmation again.
